values.note: 'All RV Camping $25.00/night', all tent camping $15. Paid at a drop box in the main restrooms when the site is occupied. Dump station $10 if not camping. Read 2026-10-31.

note: Dubois County park, 5 mi S of Jasper, with concrete-pad sites. --Claude
summary: $25, FCFS, Apr 1-Nov 1, 14-day max and showers/dump confirmed; site count 34 -> 48. Online registration mandatory from 2027 recorded in booking.note. Note cleaned.
flags: PIN looks about 500 m off: stored 38.31842,-86.88208 is on the road beside the 4-H fairgrounds' south edge. Imagery shows a gravel loop with about 15 parked RVs in the woods at about 38.3153,-86.8862 (crosshair read at z18), joined by a track running east; that is the only camp-like area in the park on imagery. No park map or OSM camp feature was available to confirm, so I give it as probable. Other sites could sit under the canopy nearby.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. The park's 2- and 3-acre lakes are about 500 m east of that loop.
PUBLIC NIGHTS: open to the general public, posted rate, county phone 812-482-2434. Google Maps 4.5 over 80. '20A' stays from the note: the county page is silent on amperage.
Booking changes in 2027: 'On-line Registrations will be mandatory. More information to follow.' Re-read then; reservable stays false until a system exists.
